summary: Name the MCP adapter fractal-chatgpt and accept both paired-client socket names

replay.detail: No graph replay or data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordination rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The adapter accepts fractal-client.sock and st3-client.sock; control sockets and other names remain rejected. The canonical Cargo binary and Nix package are fractal-chatgpt. Nix retains the st-chatgpt package alias and executable symlink in the same derivation for existing consumers. MCP server identity is fractal-chatgpt; tools and grant authority are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or service interruption is required by this adapter change.

manual.detail: Source builds should select --bin fractal-chatgpt. Existing Nix consumers may keep using the st-chatgpt package and executable during the rename bridge. Select the paired-client socket name provided by the running daemon.

recovery.detail: No persistent data is changed. An older adapter can still connect through st3-client.sock while the daemon provides that name.
